data.name: Sari
data.gender_notes: Sari is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Sari means ‘grace,’ ‘elegance,’ or ‘something fine.’ It is derived from the Hebrew word sar, which means ‘knitting,’ or ‘binding.’ In the Bible, Sarah is the name of the wife of Abraham, who was promised a son in her old age. The name Sari carries the meaning “Grace, elegance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sari usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, elegance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the grace and elegance of the divine feminine.
data.etymology: Sari belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, elegance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sari total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_greek.name: Σάρη
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Σάρη σημαίνει κυρία ή βασίλισσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σάρη προέρχεται από την αραιαϊκή λέξη 'Σαραι' που σημαίνει 'κυρία' ή 'βασίλισσα'. Στο Χριστιανισμό, το όνομα Σάρη αναφέρεται στη σύζυγο του Αβραάμ, που ήταν γνωστή ως Σαραι πριν από την αλλαγή του ονόματος σε Σάρα από τον Θεό.
